dataset_spec.name: uci_ckd
dataset_spec.description: UCI Chronic Kidney Disease cohort (400 observations, 24 predictors). Binary ckd vs notckd labels from the original donation.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult assessed at a hospital in Tamil Nadu, India (2015) for possible chronic kidney disease. The observations are age, blood pressure, urinalysis, blood chemistry and haematology, and the recorded history of hypertension, diabetes, coronary artery disease, appetite, oedema and anaemia.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Clinical history, urinalysis and blood tests:

al.scale_note: Urine albumin grade 0–5 as recorded in the original study (ordinal)

su.scale_note: Urine sugar grade 0–5 as recorded in the original study (ordinal)

ckd_status.question: Based on this clinical history and these urine and blood tests, does this patient have chronic kidney disease?
